_comment: C0-12 agentforce bodies EN. 无附加小节。正文「相关条目」1 行带 .md 链接（copilot-studio），related 写 1 条。

axes.model_access: Models are reached through the Atlas reasoning engine (OpenAI etc. via Salesforce-hosted access; official framing not verified item by item); model selection being opaque to users is normal for CRM-embedded products — this site honestly records "not verified item by item".
axes.runtime: Pure cloud hosting, deeply bound to Salesforce Data Cloud/CRM object model; no self-hosted form.
axes.local_files: The data surface is CRM objects and Data Cloud; it hosts no local-file runtime.
axes.background: Cloud-hosted and resident; connects with Flow/automation platforms (official product-page navigation includes Agentforce Builder/Voice, fetched directly 2026-10-21).
axes.tools: Actions/Topics system + MuleSoft connector ecosystem; MCP support status not verified item by item.
axes.context: CRM records and Data Cloud are the natural context source — this is its biggest structural advantage over general-purpose platforms.
axes.permissions: Permissions follow the Salesforce sharing-model/permission-set system — enterprise governance is a native Salesforce strength.
axes.fit: Fits: Salesforce-installed enterprises (service/sales scenarios), CRM context out of the box. Does not fit: outside the Salesforce ecosystem (the value anchor disappears); self-hosting.

runs: This site has not completed measured runs. The closest test protocol is the code-side [protocols/framework/_protocol.md](../../../protocols/framework/_protocol.md) (the tool-calling and credential-boundary sections are reusable; no workflow-platform-specific protocol exists on this site yet).
unknowns:
- Model selection and transparency under the Atlas engine (not verified item by item)
- MCP support status (no official documentation found)
- Feature boundaries of Agentforce Builder/Voice (product-page navigation on record; details not verified item by item)
related: Suite-embedded agent contrast: Microsoft binds M365/Power Platform, Salesforce binds CRM/Data Cloud — ecosystem binding is the shared main axis.
